sentences.text: Asio pythiotus is a newly described species of owl belonging to the genus Asio.
The Paleobiology Database currently lacks a specific entry for Asio pythiotus.
It was formally described in 2026 in the paper “Larger Owls (Aves: Strigidae) from the Lower Pleistocene of Crimea” published in Doklady Biological Sciences.
The taxon is regarded as valid by current authorities.
Fossils of the species date to the Pleistocene epoch.
The remains were recovered from deposits in Crimea.
